collection.title: Vauxhall Corsa Hatchback 1993 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Corsa 1993 to 1999 requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers sideabd the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.  We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Corsa which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
